Every blood-stage clone of a run, from onset to end

Source: R/episodes.R
episodes.Rd

One row per blood-stage clone, founder seeding included: when it became patent, how, and when and how it ended. A clone counts in state.tsv's moi_active from onset_tick to end_tick - 1, so a clone that ends on its first day (an MDA round can clear one) is never in state.tsv. A clone that ends below patency (bloodcure_subpatent) returns, if it does, as a recrudescence: a row of its own.

Usage

episodes(events)

Arguments

events

an events table from load_events(), or a run (a vivax_run or its directory).

Value

a data.table, by host, onset and pedigree id: episode_id, human_id, pedigree_id, lineage_id, onset_tick, onset_event (vh_inoculation, vh_inoculation_import, vh_inoculation_seed, hypnozoite_activation or recrudescence), end_tick (NA for a clone still patent when the run ended) and end_reason (human_clearance, case_bloodstage_clear, mda_bloodstage_clear, bloodcure_subpatent, or "ongoing"). Join classify_cases() on pedigree_id for each clone's origin; founders have none.

See also

recurrences(), classify_cases()

Examples

ep <- episodes(example_run())
head(ep)
#>    episode_id human_id pedigree_id lineage_id onset_tick           onset_event
#>        <char>    <int>       <int>     <char>      <int>                <char>
#> 1:        0:1        0           0          0          1   vh_inoculation_seed
#> 2:        1:1        1           1          1          1   vh_inoculation_seed
#> 3:      1:340        1        1215          7        340        vh_inoculation
#> 4:        2:1        2           2          2          1   vh_inoculation_seed
#> 5:      2:230        2         577          2        230        vh_inoculation
#> 6:      2:237        2         596          2        237 hypnozoite_activation
#>    end_tick      end_reason
#>       <int>          <char>
#> 1:       73 human_clearance
#> 2:      107 human_clearance
#> 3:      353 human_clearance
#> 4:      213 human_clearance
#> 5:      279 human_clearance
#> 6:      261 human_clearance
